question: Does the frozen vacancy-only axis-completion set cover all three views of wholly new seventh-family door 3 at IoU 0.5 while retaining at most three truth-blind hypotheses?

preserved_contributors: best semantic-local fusion candidate constrained to the majority winning target reference across the three query observations
hypothesis_generation.vacancy_rule: Deduplicate the three preserved contributors by exact original candidate key. Only when fewer than three distinct candidates remain, append at most one reference-scale axis completion if its output box is not already present. Never remove or replace a preserved candidate.
hypothesis_generation.axis_completion: For every detector proposal, consider its unchanged box, a full-width horizontal band retaining its y span, and a full-height vertical band retaining its x span. Rank all options by the parent layer-18 local score minus 0.05 times minimum absolute log-area deviation to any frozen reference target scale.
hypothesis_generation.reference_vote: Each query contributes its semantic-local fusion top-one winning target reference. Select the majority reference; break ties by deterministic sorted reference order.
hypothesis_generation.truth_boundary: Reference vote, preserved contributors, deduplication, vacancy availability, axis mode and scores are fixed before target boxes or IoU are opened. Truth is used only to evaluate the resulting set.
hypothesis_generation.downstream_contract: The bounded set remains unresolved localization uncertainty and requires active or cross-view disambiguation before one target can be authorized.

literature_motivation.source: Dynamic Tiling: A Model-Agnostic, Adaptive, Scalable, and Inference-Data-Centric Approach for Efficient and Accurate Small Object Detection
literature_motivation.use: Initial near-boundary detections can guide adaptive spatial completion for objects fragmented by fixed tiling. Mechanism motivation only.

literature_motivation.source: Aspect Ratio and Context Aware Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks for Object Detection
literature_motivation.use: Multiple aspect-ratio configurations and surrounding context motivate a bounded elongated-object completion candidate. Mechanism motivation only.

claim_boundary: This is the first wholly new physical family after the six-family vacancy rule was frozen. A pass is narrow same-provider fresh-family bounded proposal coverage, not top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, open-set rejection, provider independence, raw-phone operation, referent ownership, named entrance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability or safety.
